renderer.tool: macOS Quick Look qlmanage thumbnail renderer
renderer.installed_office: Keynote 13.2 was present; automated open stalled, and was not treated as a qualified headless renderer. No PowerPoint or LibreOffice headless renderer was available.
renderer.limit: Quick Look previews are actual rendered PPTX previews but not Office-engine compatibility proof. Package-native chart semantics are extracted independently.

observations: A, B, C and D values in the 90s or single digits appear against broad 0–200/0–20 preview axes, flattening visible variation.
C source has separate control/treatment weekly series; output has one LINE_MARKERS series with duplicated week categories. C Box Plot and B Box Plot source views output LINE_MARKERS.
All six editable decks retain readable headline, KPI/comparison, narrative and decision/action text as extractable shapes; tables are extractable.
B wafer map and process flow remain visible in preview; distribution/control chart meanings are not fully preserved.
Quick Look layout evidence has a renderer caveat; type/series mapping is PPTX package fact.
